hana_sales: Customer POC (poc-orion) reports duplicate trace IDs in their logging backend after enabling our export. They're upset—correlation broken and some missing spans.
leo_sre: Do we have an example export line? is the trace_id short or full length?
hana_sales: They attached a snippet: ```{"trace_id":"deadbeef", "path":"/v1/query", "ts":1710000000}``` multiple different requests show the same trace_id.
mark_runtime: That looks like an 8-byte id. We had a legacy compatibility transform that collapses 32-char hex to 8 when compatibility_mode=true. It should not be on for new POCs.
anya_support: We also saw intermittent 429s from their collector in our logs during bursts. Could be retries causing duplicate lines with truncated ids.
leo_sre: Quick remediation: disable compatibility_mode for workspace poc-orion and set REDWOOD_EXPORT_CONCURRENCY=2, REDWOOD_EXPORT_BATCH_MAX=40 to reduce pressure.
mark_runtime: I'll push a hotfix to stop truncating on export and add a runtime guard to prefer otel.trace_id when present. Filing ENG-11011.
export-bot: Deploy started for poc-orion/hotfix commit=3f8a1
export-bot: Deploy succeeded in 1m30s
anya_support: After deploy and lowering concurrency, customer reports new exports show full 32-char trace_ids and duplicates stopped. They requested a re-ingest for a 30m window to fix historical collisions.
mark_runtime: We can run a reprocess job but will dedupe by event_id + full trace_id to avoid creating duplicates. Job queued: reprocess-2026-03-21.
leo_sre: I'll add a temporary dashboard for them: Observability -> Exports -> create panel for export.4xx_count and distinct(trace_id) per minute so they can watch collisions vanish.
hana_sales: ETA to reprocess? customer needs a confirmation.
mark_runtime: Reprocess scheduled for tonight UTC; estimate 20m. ENG-11011 will go into next patch to remove the fallback permanently.
anya_support: Customer happy with fix and monitoring. Closing thread but leaving ENG ticket open. :thumbsup:
